messages:
maria: Quick check — noticed during the access-heatmap run that a bunch of service-admin entitlements reappeared after KMS rotation window last night. Did anyone else see this? cc @sam

sam: I saw alerts from access-bot. Likely rebinds after key rollover. Which key?

maria: Key: projects/redwood-prod/keyRings/infra/cryptoKeys/inference-rot. Logs show `iam:binding.created` for role `roles/owner` on svcacct analytics-replay@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com around 02:13 UTC.

leo: Whoa. can you paste the audit line?

maria: ```json
{
  "protoPayload": {
    "methodName": "SetIamPolicy",
    "resourceName": "projects/-/serviceAccounts/analytics-replay@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com",
    "request": {
      "policy": {
        "bindings": [{ "role": "roles/owner", "members": ["serviceAccount:analytics-replay@..."] }]
      }
    }
  },
  "timestamp": "2025-11-02T02:13:21Z"
}
```

nina: If bindings were re-created by deploy tooling, we need to update the KMS grant flow. Quick triage — are these owner roles or admin roles with broad perms?

maria: Mostly owner on a handful of old SAs used by legacy batch jobs. I think rotation caused the key decrypt step to fail, tooling retried and re-applied a terraform state with expanded perms? :thinking_face:

access-bot: Automated note: 7 entitlements flagged, owners missing for 5, recommended action: ownerproof required, temp-suspend, run leastpriv script.

sam: Plan: freeze those SAs, collect owner proofs, run `leastpriv --dry-run --svc=analytics-replay` and schedule staged removal. Also add a canary rollback in deploys. Assigning @leo to collect owner proof.

leo: On it. I'll add findings to the ticket and post snippet of `gcloud iam service-accounts get-iam-policy analytics-replay@redwood-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com` output.

maria: Also we should patch the rotation runbook — add pre-check that terraform state hasn't drifted and a `kms:decrypt` smoke test. Proposed snippet:

```bash
# smoke test to verify KMS decrypt path before rotation
echo "test" | gcloud kms decrypt --location=global --keyring=infra --key=inference-rot --ciphertext=- --plaintext=- || exit 1
```

nina: Agree. Also add automated watch in console: alert when `iam.binding` created for owner role outside infra-admin group. I'll add ACL in the alert policy.

sam: :thumbsup: I'll draft PR for runbook + alert. Target EOD.

maria: Thanks — temp-suspend done for 5 SAs (suspension ids: SA-SUS-1201..1205). Leaving thread open until ownerproofs collected. Anyone else?

leo: Uploading ownerproof doc to ticket: https://redwood.example/t/SEC-1345

access-bot: Status update: ownerproof count 1/5. Next reminder in 24h.
